visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with curly dark brown hair and red-framed glasses stands on a sunny city sidewalk. She wears a white floral patterned blouse and carries a large, colorful striped shopping bag. She holds a smartphone with a pink case to her ear, speaking with an exaggerated, loud facial expression. (2) The woman is sitting on a white ornate bench under a tree. A purple bus passes by on the street. She suddenly stands up, gestures wildly with her hands, and begins running after the bus along the sidewalk. (3) The scene shifts to the woman standing beneath a large tree, holding a white calculator and a clear bag of tomatoes. She gestures emphatically with her free hand as if arguing or bargaining, with animated math equations appearing as overlays around her. (4) Inside a living room, the woman leans over a brown couch, searching frantically under blankets. She then pulls a pink foldable tablet/phone from her pocket and begins using it with a look of realization. (5) A split-screen video call view shows a close-up of the woman adjusting her glasses and talking. A smaller inset window shows another young woman in a yellow top. The main subject's expressions are lively and exaggerated. (6) The woman is shown in bed under a red-and-white checkered blanket, then in a room with indoor plants, holding a spray bottle. She holds up a new blue iPhone 17 Pro to the camera, showcasing the device's design. (7) Outdoors again, she stands with a young man in a blue t-shirt, pointing at her phone screen. The young man leans in to assist her as she looks through her glasses with a curious expression.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged woman with short, voluminous curly dark hair, wearing red-framed glasses, a white floral lace-style short-sleeved blouse, and light-colored trousers. She wears a jade-colored bracelet and an orange bead bracelet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: City sidewalks with trees and traffic signs, a white park bench, an indoor living room with a brown couch and white walls, a bedroom with a patterned blanket, and an office-like setting with green plants and partitions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice speaking loudly in Mandarin with an exaggerated, comedic tone. A fast-tempo, bright comedic BGM with strong electronic beats and synthesized melodies starts immediately. (2) Sudden vocal shout followed by a short comedic 'whoosh' SFX. Low-frequency rumble of a bus engine is audible underneath the continuous, upbeat BGM. (3) Constant rapid speech from the primary female voice. High-pitched digital 'ding' and calculation pings are synchronized with visual math overlays. The vocal delivery maintains a high pitch and persistent rhythm. (4) Fabric rustling and soft thuds are heard as the speaker searches for an object. The vocal tone shifts to a slightly muffled, anxious mutter, then brightens with a digital 'notification' SFX when she finds her phone. (5) Overlapping female voices create a busy, chatter-filled acoustic space. The primary voice remains dominant and projected. No environmental noise is detected, maintaining a clean studio production feel. (6) Vocal tone transitions to a professional narrative style, slightly lower in pitch but clearly enunciated. Several digital UI pings and bubble sounds highlight mentions of 'iPhone 17' and '5G'. BGM energy swells. (7) Introduction of low-level outdoor ambient traffic hum. Interaction between the main female voice and a calm male voice. BGM tempo remains consistent until a final brand jingle or stinger concludes the audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Relatable Scenes (1-7) -> Commercial Pivot -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To use humorous, stereotypical portrayals of Taiwanese 'Auntie' (Da Ma) behaviors to capture viewer attention and relate to common tech struggles, ultimately promoting Chunghwa Telecom's iPhone 17 upgrade program and 5G network quality.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logos, product features, specific pricing/discount information, and call to action to visit Chunghwa Telecom.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends cultural comedy with commercial content. The rapid editing and high-arousal audio keep the audience engaged through various humorous segments before the direct sales pitch.
